secret_scan_policy: Values are never included in findings or logs. Explicit credential formats only; no account/session directories, decryption, network fetching, binary OCR or general secret-absence guarantee.
absolute_path_note: Evidence records retain observed command/trace paths. Only reproduction sources and Notebook code require portability review; no evidence was altered.
local_link_scope: Parsed CommonMark links and images: local file existence checked; fragments and external URLs not fetched.
remaining_final_checks: Repeat this script after all real mode/evaluation runs and current artifacts are frozen.
Independently verify complete acceptance, final Notebook Run All, figure source/version bindings and actual visual review.
Recheck final diff and staged contents, including substantive ignored logs; never stage caches or user ZIPs implicitly.
Verify fixed CODE_SHA/ARTIFACT_SHA and actual pushed remote files after authorized publication.
scope_limits: Static engineering publication preparation is not scientific acceptance or permission to publish.
Cache files are reported and left untouched; original files and archives are only read.
Package inventory is checked against the recorded reused environment; this script performs no installations.
